summary: Pair 3 occupies the Day 3 slot exactly: blending three sounds into a CVC word, reversing Day 1's segmentation using Day 2's letter-sound knowledge. Both characters anchor the lesson with consistent voice. Materials remain everyday only — sound box cards, letter index cards, word slips written in marker. The expanded_walkthrough names the choppy-blend trap (pauses break fusion) with concrete recovery moves including the long-vowel-hold gesture. Worksheet introduces 2 transfer words (FOX, JET) in Part 3 to verify generalisation beyond rote. Pair 3 cleared to scale to pair 4.
